def factor_volume_price_corr_logvol(df):
    """Rolling correlation between price changes and log-volume changes."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_chg = np.log1p(df_copy["volume"]).pct_change()
    corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=5).corr(vol_chg)
    corr = corr.fillna(0.0)
    corr.name = "factor_volume_price_corr_logvol"
    return corr
description: Preserves parent's core rolling price-volume correlation mechanism and RankICIR/payoff monotonicity. Bottleneck: low MI from raw volume percent-change outliers. Mutation replaces raw volume percent change with log-volume percent change (log1p then pct_change), a bounded smoothing that reduces extreme volume spikes' dominance while retaining signed volume direction. This should improve nonlinear price-volume dependency without altering sign interpretation or requiring cross-sectional transform.
